entities.summary: French writer Jacques Natanson first became involved in the movies in 1929 when one of his plays was adapted for the screen. He enjoyed a fruitful collaboration with Max Ophüls, on such films as La Ronde, Le Plaisir (1952), and Lola Montès (1955).
